outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models, and individual data points (colored dots for SCLC, LUSC, LUAD) are overlaid on each bar, showing the underlying replicate values.
Panel B is a schematic illustration of the experimental workflow (Ad-Cre administration, MRI imaging, sacrifice/harvest), not a plot of quantitative data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C shows representative MRI images of mice, not a plot presenting averaged data.
Panel D shows representative H&E histology micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images with annotated regions, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrographs comparing squamous tumors and normal lung, not a plot of averaged quantitative data.
Panel G shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images with annotations, not a plot of averaged data.
